label: Documented: phase 005 pushes its first packet commit to public main, clones the public HTTPS URL, and sweeps that clone. The sweep precedes T017, the later evidence push. T017 checks that local HEAD equals origin/main and records run status, but it does not repeat the path and content sweeps against that final tip. T007 pulls after the trigger-index rebuild but counts only trigger-index.json. The workflow also commits three trigger-index sidecars, so a final full sweep is missing after bot output. Amend phase 005 tasks.md and acceptance-criteria.md to rerun the full sweep after T017 and after the final bot commit.

Confirmed: T004 checks four path/content identifiers and scans uppercase WEBFLOW/OBSIDIAN tokens only in the two sk-code trees; the spec correctly notes --no-verify bypasses the hook. Inferred: this establishes absence of those markers, not absence of arbitrary private bytes copied under a renamed path or as partial content. Amend phase 005 tasks.md and acceptance-criteria.md with a reachable-blob hash comparison for every complete file under the local-webflow and local-obsidian roots, plus a named secret/content scanner if partial fragments are in scope.

Documented: the Obsidian Plugin repository symlinks runtime directories at its root back to this hub, and stack detection resolves those links. Phase 005 T008 probes only the operator checkout. Inferred: moving the Obsidian surface to a local skill can change routing for that linked repository, while the current phase proof does not exercise that consumer. Amend phase 005 tasks.md and acceptance-criteria.md with a symlink-target and routing probe from the Obsidian Plugin checkout; its active path is UNKNOWN because that checkout was not inspected.

Documented: phase 005 says removed content stays in Git history and leaves filter-repo plus force-push as an optional operator decision. Inferred: ordinary removal commits preserve prior content through reachable ancestors, and tags or release archives that retain an older tree can preserve another copy. Local refs include tag refs, but this iteration did not map individual tags to removed blobs or inspect hosted release assets, so their contents are UNKNOWN. Amend phase 005 spec.md and tasks.md with a refs/tags and release-asset inventory, keeping any history rewrite as a separate operator decision.

Confirmed: routing-registry-drift runs root metadata, leaf-manifest, derived-freshness, skill-graph compiler, router-signal, and graph-freshness checks. The root metadata and derived scanners enumerate direct skill directories without excluding local-*; the compiler also scans direct graph-metadata children. Inferred: a developer-local rerun can include ignored private roots and fail if their metadata or derived fields are invalid or stale; existence alone does not guarantee failure. Amend phase 005 tasks.md and acceptance-criteria.md to run the named checks with both local skills present and record the expected result.
